paragraphs: FlashVote sells rapid opinion surveys to local governments, promising statistically valid public input in 48 hours on any issue. The company claims its professionally designed scientific surveys are up to 90% faster, easier and more affordable for local governments.

The service works by getting large samples of representative residents to answer professionally designed questions. It reaches those residents by email, text and phone. Results are reported 48 hours after a survey launches. To keep outsiders from skewing the numbers, the system filters results by physical addresses.

The company says it works with local governments in more than 30 states. Its customers are described as counties, cities, towns and special districts. FlashVote is the first good-government service offered by the Governance Sciences Group.
